title: Its OK
text:
Its OK. I was a little disappointed by how small it is in person. The pictures imply one can use it with a dumped bin of legos, playing and then cleaning it up. So we got one with that purpose in mind. Unfortunately, that's a bit optimistic. The play area is too small, no kid I know who is young enough to be making a mess with legos can play in such a confined space without dumping the pieces elsewhere, and there's no way a large pile of legos will actually fit back into the bag for carrying. I feel like bigger kids can be disciplined enough to play in the confined area and use this for a specific set with a finite amount of bricks, but then they are also big enough to clean up after themselves which in my head at least defeats the purpose of this bag.
It does work for things like markers, which is cool and useful, but we got it because of the picture implying it would be good for small messy toys like Legos, and in real life that just doesn't seem practical. Unless you are only bringing small amounts at a time, like less than they show in the images.
I'm a little disappointed for our use.
